description: This file is the bootstrap and initialization code for CanvasKit, a WebAssembly-based rendering library. It contains code to load, instantiate, and interact with WebAssembly modules related to graphics and rendering, including functions for creating surfaces, drawing on canvases, managing graphics resources, and defining graphics primitives and configurations.
